thesis: The episode explores the people and process behind capital allocation through conversations with leaders in the money game. It features Roz Hewsenian, the chief investment officer of the $6 billion Helmsley Charitable Trust, who discusses her career trajectory from teaching learning-challenged children to obtaining an MBA and her current role in managing the trust.
